§ 03

Frequently asked.

When does settla launch?
We're targeting Q4 2026 on iOS. Join the waitlist and we'll send a single email the day it's live.
Is settla coming to Android?
Not at launch. We're focused on building the best possible experience on iPhone first.
What will it cost?
We'll share pricing closer to launch. Waitlist members will hear first, and we plan a free tier.
Why so little detail right now?
We'd rather show you a finished product than a half-finished idea. There'll be plenty to talk about closer to launch.
Who is behind settla?
An independent team based in Oslo, Norway. Reach us anytime via the support link below.
